jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Driven to be the Best

People. Performance. Purpose.

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

An Avis General Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall performance and profitability of the used vehicle sales operation, leading the sales team to meet and exceed targets. This role includes forecasting sales, managing inventory, and ensuring the team is well-trained, motivated, and knowledgeable about all vehicles. The General Manager also handles hiring, performance management, and customer issue resolution, while assisting with deal closings when needed. Additionally, they monitor sales metrics, implement marketing and promotional strategies, finalize sales and trade-in agreements, and collaborate with rental operations to support remarketing efforts, all while maintaining strong customer service and operational excellence.

What you’ll do:

- Responsible to consistently and profitably meet used vehicle sales quotas through expert management and leadership of the sales team
- Forecast sales, maintain proper inventory levels in terms of amount and vehicle types, and motivate the sales team
- Responsible for hiring, training, and monitoring team member performance. He/she is responsible for the resolution of customer complaints and to assist in closings when necessary
- Train the sales team on sales methodologies that support established sales targets
- Train sales team to become subject matter experts on all vehicles and vehicle specifications/features in the inventory
- Establish sales quotas for each sales representative and provide continuous feedback in order to manage to overall sales goals
- Continuously monitor and adjust inventory to optimize customer choice
- Measure and report sales metrics; monitor actuals-to-plan
- Continuously and consistently promote the dealership, its values, and its products/services
- Finalizing Purchase, Trade-in, and Sales agreements, contracts, etc.
- Utilizing e-commerce tools, i.e. social media, listing services, inventory systems, etc.
- Executing advertising and promotional plans
- Assisting with various Remarketing initiatives
- Work closely with ABG Car Rental facilities

Perks You’ll Get:

- Access to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance
- Eligible to elect other voluntary benefits including: Group Auto Insurance, Group Home Insurance, Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, FSA, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and additional life insurance coverages
- 401(k) Retirement Plan with company matched contributions
- Full training to learn the business and enhance professional skills
- Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars
- Access to an Employee Assistance Program for services including counseling, financial and legal consultation, referrals for care service and more

What we’re looking for:

- High school diploma required, Bachelor’s degree preferred
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Retail Car Sales Management position.
- Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
- General business knowledge to successfully operate and manage a corporate retail store
- Excellent customer service skills
- Strong organizational and analytical skills to track all appropriate operational measures and analyze and forecast operational performance results
- Strong communication and coaching skills.  Ability to interact with both internal and external customers at all levels.  Ability to manage and motivate staff in a team environment
- Requires problem solving and decision-making skills
- Strong understanding of marketing programs, events and promotions
- Must be proficient with various computer applications including social media and mobile applications

Who We Are:

Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance driven, where we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

We are proud to make a positive difference to the lives of our colleagues, customers, and communities where we operate.

Avis Budget Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other category protected by applicable law.

Essential functions and responsibilities may change as business needs require. The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. This position may be with any affiliate of Avis Budget Group.

jobs.description:
The annual starting salary for this position is $65,000 annually. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Here at Avis Budget Group, you’ll be joining a team of 25,000 driven people performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward through innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance-driven — we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

Leveraging its core strengths in large scale fleet management, Avis Budget Group has entered into a strategic partnership with the leader in self-driving technology, to launch and scale a fully autonomous ride-hailing service in Dallas.  This new strategic partnership reflects the Company’s ambition to grow beyond travel and actively shape the future of mobility.  Sound your speed? Come join our family.

As the Fleet Operations Manager, AV Fleet you will oversee daily fleet operations for autonomous ride-hailing vehicles. Your work will focus on leading a team to ensure operational excellence in servicing, cleaning, charging, and calibration of autonomous vehicles. The Fleet Operations Manager ensures that all vehicles meet readiness, safety, and quality standards while maximizing fleet utilization (uptime) while ensuring customers in the Dallas market have access to clean and ready autonomous vehicles when needed.

- Assist with all areas of the employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, training, recognition, motivation, development and performance management to enable a high-performance culture.

- Excellent organization and prioritization skills, self-starter, able to work in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision

jobs.description:

Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

We're looking for an FP&A Manager to lead financial reporting and performance analysis across our rental business segments, and to serve as the primary link between Sales and Finance — connecting commercial performance to financial results. The person in this role owns the strategic development of our profit allocation tool. Because the tool's evolution depends on inputs and collaboration from IT, Risk, and other Finance functions, this role requires someone who can drive cross-functional alignment as much as they can build a model.

What You'll Do:

- Own segment-level P&L reporting and performance analysis, delivering insights that connect business results to underlying drivers (rate, volume, mix, cost)
- Act as the primary bridge between Sales and Finance — ensuring commercial teams understand financial performance and Finance understands what's driving it operationally
- Lead the ongoing development and refinement of the revenue/cost profit allocation tool
- Design and validate driver-based allocation methodologies for non-directly attributable costs, and prioritize the roadmap for tool enhancements while managing dependencies across departments
- Coordinate with IT, Risk, and other Finance departments to secure data, systems support, and sign-off needed to advance the allocation tool
- Drive sales teams’ adoption of the profit allocation tool through hands-on training and support in interpreting results
- Manage, coach, and develop the FP&A Analyst
- Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in Finance and Sales leadership
- Establish and improve reporting processes, controls, and documentation for the allocation methodology
- Identify opportunities to apply automation, SQL/Python tooling, and AI to improve reporting speed and accuracy

What We're Looking For:

- Strong command of P&L structure, cost allocation concepts, and financial analysis
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills — able to design allocation logic from first principles, not just execute existing models
- Strong communication skills, comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders
- Advanced Excel skills; strong command of the Microsoft Office suite
- Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
- Prior people management or mentorship experience preferred
- Experience with or strong interest in applying AI tools to finance/reporting workflows is a plus

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or related field; MBA a plus but not required

jobs.title: City Manager-Director of Operations-Airport
jobs.description:
Here at Avis Budget Group , you’ll be joining a team of 25,000 driven people performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward through innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance-driven — we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

We’re proud to make a positive difference in the lives of our colleagues, customers, and the communities where we operate.

The impact you’ll make:
The City Manager leads, manages, and develops Denver City to achieve operational excellence, financial profitability, and sustained growth. This role has full accountability for city performance across operations, fleet, people, customer experience, and financial results, including ownership of fleet utilization and asset productivity.

The City Manager develops and executes city operating plans aligned to regional and company strategies, ensures disciplined execution of operational standards, and drives continuous improvement. This role serves as the fleet command leader for the city, leveraging Compass and other data-driven tools to optimize lot flow, reduce dwell time, increase utilization, and accelerate vehicles to the Readyline—ultimately improving revenue, cost performance, and customer satisfaction.

Additionally, the City Manager acts as a change agent and Compass owner , ensuring adoption, accuracy, and sustained optimization of Compass as a core operating platform across all city locations.

What you’ll do:
(Includes but is not limited to the following; responsibilities may vary based on city assignment.)
City & Financial Leadership
- Lead, manage, and develop an assigned city to operational success and financial profitability across all functional areas.
- Develop, implement, and communicate city operating plans that maximize revenue, market share, and profitability in alignment with company objectives and guidelines.
- Monitor performance against plan; establish or revise strategies, procedures, and standards to improve results and mitigate risk.
- Set monthly performance goals for each location, including revenue, revenue per unit, transactions, utilization, incremental sales, and customer experience metrics.
- Forecast, budget, and manage key financial drivers, including revenue, transactions, market segment mix, utilization, fleet mix, wage expense, daily dollar average, revenue per unit, incremental revenue penetration, and fleet size.
- Grow revenue and profit while maintaining disciplined cost control and productivity standards.

Fleet Ownership & Asset Management
- Direct and control fleet distribution activities to ensure optimal vehicle availability across city locations.
- Oversee fleet maintenance, repair, and reconditioning activities to ensure safety, quality, and readiness standards are met.
- Evaluate physical inventories to establish and maintain the appropriate fleet mix, age profile, and asset deployment.
- Analyze DOR and operational reports to improve utilization, return on investment, and fleet velocity.

Compass Leadership & Fleet Command
- Serve as the primary Compass owner and point of contact for the city.
- Ensure compliance, accuracy, and consistent usage of Compass reporting across all locations.
- Leverage Compass to gain real-time visibility into vehicle location, condition, dwell time, and lot flow to optimize fleet performance.
- Lead the development and ongoing optimization of lot flow strategies across rental markets within the city.
- Analyze Compass and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Conduct detailed operational assessments and implement process improvements to reduce dwell time, increase efficiency, and accelerate vehicles to the Readyline.
- Identify and recommend Compass enhancements to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and overall business value.

Change Leadership & Adoption
- Act as a change agent for Compass, ensuring effective two-way communication between frontline teams and project stakeholders.
- Ensure teams are informed, trained, and prepared for Compass-related changes and enhancements.
- Gather feedback from users, escalate risks and issues, and support resolution to ensure successful adoption.
- Support and enable Change Agents by:
- Cascading information, updates, and resources.
- Providing time and resources for training and meetings.
- Encouraging open communication and feedback.
- Recognizing and celebrating contributions to drive engagement and accountability.

People Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness
- Hire, lead, coach, develop, and evaluate management and employee staff across all city locations.
- Establish, communicate, and monitor clear objectives aligned with company goals.
- Implement HR policies related to performance management, discipline, and development in a consistent, fair, and compliant manner.
- Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

Stakeholder & External Relations
- Partner with Corporate Sales and Marketing to support sales strategies, long-range objectives, and local marketing initiatives.
- Build and maintain professional relationships with local business organizations and governmental agencies to protect company interests and resolve issues.
- Ensure Quality Assurance standards and operational compliance are consistently met.

Supervisory Responsibilities
- Direct supervisory responsibility for select management and staff within the city.
- Indirect supervisory responsibility for all employees across the city.

Responsibility Scope / Impact
This role has significant impact on the operational performance, financial results, asset utilization, customer experience, and employee engagement of the city. The City Manager exercises substantial independent judgment in managing daily operations, fleet ownership, asset deployment, utilization, and return on investment. Decisions are made within established policies and procedures, with escalation as required.
Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field (or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience).
- Five or more years of operations and sales experience, with at least one year in a supervisory role; vehicle rental or related industry experience strongly preferred. (Experience requirements may vary by city assignment.)
- Strong general business acumen with the ability to lead multiple locations and complex operations.
- Proven ability to lead through change and drive adoption of new tools and processes.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into action.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- Demonstrated coaching and people leadership capability in a multi-location environment.
- Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.

The annual salary range for this position is $118,000-$144,000 annually.
Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Avis Budget Group is an equal opportunity employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled.

Dans le cadre d’une création de poste, nous recherchons pour les marques FRANCECARS et AVIS, un(e)  FP&A / Contrôleur de gestion opérationnelle RH (F/H) , en contrat CDI à compter du mois d’octobre 2026. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis, à contribuer à un environnement de travail épanouissant, et à avoir un impact positif sur nos résultats, alors  POSTULEZ !
Rattaché(e) à Elise, la Superviseur FP&A, votre mission sera de fournir des reportings de suivi et des analyses fiables sur les performances opérationnelles, commerciales et sociales, et d’accompagner les managers AVIS et France Cars dans le pilotage de leur activité et la prise de décision.

Vos principales missions seront :

Pour AVIS :
● La mise en place d’objectifs sur la performance vente et la satisfaction client pour les équipes opérationnelles
● La création et l’entretien des reporting de suivi de performances (KPI) Week /Monthly /Year
● Le calcul des primes des équipes opérationnelles sur la base des performances mensuelles et annuelles

Pour Francecars :
● Le déploiement et le suivi de reportings visant la maitrise de la masse salariale et des ETP
● L’élaboration des budgets annuels et les prévisions mensuelles (forecast) liés aux RH
● La participation aux clôtures mensuelles dans les délais définis (J+3) via l’analyse et suivi des ETP et de la masse salariale (dont intérimaires)
● La définition, le calcul et le suivi objectifs des équipes opérationnelles sur une base mensuelle, trimestrielle et annuelle

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous :

● Etes diplômé(e) bac +5 en Contrôle de Gestion, et que vous avez à une expérience réussie d’au moins 3 ans sur un poste similaire dans un environnement multisites (alternance comprise)
● Aimez analyser les données, maîtrisez Excel, Power Query et Power Pivot, Tableau Desktop et Tableau Prep,              SQL (PostgreSQL / Oracle SQL)
● Avez une communication efficace qui vous permet d’interagir avec la direction groupe et les managers opérationnels
● Etes force de proposition, rigoureux(se) et que vous positionnez en tant que Business Partner
● Parlez anglais de façon fluide type B2/C1 (l’anglais est un atout pour évoluer au sein de notre groupe)
● Aimez partager votre énergie, votre optimisme et votre bonne humeur avec vos collègues

Nous rejoindre c’est bénéficier :

● D’un salaire brut annuel à partir de 36000 euros (selon profil et expérience) et d’un contrat statut cadre avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine
● D’une prime annuelle allant jusqu'à 10 % de votre salaire
● De réelles opportunités d'évolution interne dans l’ensemble de nos marques et à l’échelle internationale : 70% de nos managers ont été promus en interne !
● De remises sur vos locations de voitures pour vous et vos proches

Notre process de recrutement est efficace et clairement défini (vous aurez 3 entretiens au maximum dans un intervalle de temps court), et nous garantissons une réponse à chaque candidat ayant postulé. Au quotidien, nous développons l’inclusion et la diversité, afin que chaque individu, quels que soient ses origines, genre, âge ou handicap, puisse être recruter ou promu pour sa personnalité et ses compétences.
En 2024, nous avons obtenu le label Silver Ecovadis qui souligne notre engagement en matière de RSE depuis plusieurs années notamment en matière d’achats responsables et de décarbonisation de notre activé.

Nous sommes 25000 collaborateurs à travers le monde animés par une seule ambition commune : « être le meilleur chaque jour, afin qu’ensemble, nous puissions devenir la meilleure entreprise de location de véhicules au monde ». Nous sommes Avis Budget Group, REJOIGNEZ-NOUS !
#driventobethebest

jobs.title: Analyst - Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.location: 1 Convair Dr East, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 6Z9
jobs.description:
Job Summary – Analyst - Financial Planning and Analysis
Performs financial calculations and provides summary of data to create various reports, charts, and presentations relevant to the organization’s finance function.  Monitors and analyzes business trends and forecasts for both the organization and its competitors using publicly available data.  Provides financial data to organization’s management, corporate functions, auditors, and SEC filings.  Essential duties and responsibilities, shown below, will vary accordingly based on assignment.

Salary range : $60,000 to $62,000 yearly

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
- Performs various financial calculations, including budgeting, depreciation, working capital, P&L, investment, and other financial and expense performance comparisons.
- Creates specified ad hoc reports, graphs, and charts of financial data.
- Consolidate and analyze capital expenditure reporting across all regions and brands including monthly variance analysis and prioritization of key projects.
- Consolidate interest expense reporting and forecasting across regions working closely with Treasury to understand changes in funding levels and update monthly forecasts.
- Update monthly depreciation and amortization forecast for the Americas region including monthly variance explains.
- Provides financial information and support to the organization’s management, corporate functions, and auditors.
- Analyze and review monthly financial reporting package for senior leadership consolidating key financial metrics and risks and opportunities for the remainder of the fiscal year.
- Assist in the month end close by analyzing expense accounts and prepare accurate calculation for accounting adjustments as required.
- Assist in periodic forecast and budgeting process via close coordination with area heads/ operations and other departments.

Supervisory Responsibilities
This position does not have formal supervision responsibilities.

Responsibility Scope/Impact (only applies to job families and field positions)
- Level I and Level II work under the direct supervision of management or more senior analysts to prepare and summarize basic financial data.  These positions have limited accountability for interpreting business results.  Level l typically has a minimum of 1 year of financial analysis experience. Level II has a minimum of 3 years financial analysis experience.
- Level lll works independently on most routine tasks to prepare, research, and summarize more complex financial data.  This position may be accountable for interpreting business results. Level IIl has a minimum of 4 years of financial analysis experience.

Qualifications
Required Experience
- Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
- Minimum of 2 years’ experience in finance analysis function.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
- Knowledge of the financial calculations, reporting, and valuation methodologies.
- Working understanding of computer application tools to perform financial calculations.  Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
- Requires excellent analytical ability, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and in teams.
Knowledge of Hyperion Brio, Wizard Mainframe, and Hyperion Essbase is a plus.

Perks You’ll Get:
- Bi-weekly Pay
- On-the-job training
- Paid time off
- Medical, Dental benefits
- Retirement benefits (Group RRSP)
- Employee discounts

Travel Requirements
Minimal travel is required.

Who are we?
Glad you asked! Avis Budget Group is a leading provider of mobility options, with brands including Avis, Budget & Budget Truck and Zipcar. With more than 70 years of experience and 11,000 locations in 180 countries, we are shaping the future of our industry and want you to join us in our mission. Apply today to get connected to an exciting career, a supportive family of employees and a world of opportunities.
